item.title: Landscape Character Areas (LCA) source files
item.subtitle: Designated & Protected Sites / DAERA, Northern Ireland Environment Agency
item.description: The Northern Ireland Landscape Character Assessment (NIEA, 2000) subdivides the countryside into 130 Landscape Character Areas based on local geology, landform, land use, settlement and ecology. LCAs underpin landscape policy and planning decisions.
